import numpy as np, math
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

# helpers
def unit(v):
    n=np.linalg.norm(v)
    return v/n if n else v

def rot_align(a,b):
    a=unit(a); b=unit(b)
    v=np.cross(a,b); c=np.dot(a,b); s=np.linalg.norm(v)
    if s<1e-10:
        if c>0: return np.eye(3)
        # rotate 180 about an axis perpendicular to a
        tmp=np.array([1.,0,0]) if abs(a[0])<.8 else np.array([0.,1,0])
        v=unit(np.cross(a,tmp)); return 2*np.outer(v,v)-np.eye(3)
    K=np.array([[0,-v[2],v[1]],[v[2],0,-v[0]],[-v[1],v[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3)+K+K@K*((1-c)/(s*s))

def axisrot(axis,theta):
    a=unit(axis); K=np.array([[0,-a[2],a[1]],[a[2],0,-a[0]],[-a[1],a[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3)*math.cos(theta)+(1-math.cos(theta))*np.outer(a,a)+math.sin(theta)*K

def xyz_coords(conf):
    return np.array(conf.GetPositions())

        v=unit(np.cross(a,tmp)); return 2*np.outer(v,v)-np.eye(3)
    K=np.array([[0,-v[2],v[1]],[v[2],0,-v[0]],[-v[1],v[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3)+K+K@K*((1-c)/(s*s))
def axisrot(axis,theta):
    a=unit(axis); K=np.array([[0,-a[2],a[1]],[a[2],0,-a[0]],[-a[1],a[0],0]])

    if AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)!=0: raise RuntimeError('embed failed')
    if AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m): AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=800)
